The 112 test rounds showing bitwise equality confirms this — the infection exists but doesn't propagate.

The mutant is **unkillable** under the fixed shape [128, 4000]. The mutation is reachable (thread 160 executes an extra iteration), but the effect (out-of-bounds write to shared[4000]) does not propagate to observable output.
